description:
The moment Pip realizes the police won't investigate her stalker isn't a plot convenience.

That's the heart of As Good As Dead by Holly Jackson — and it's not the story you remember.

A deep analysis of "As Good As Dead" by Holly Jackson — the characters, the turning points, the themes, and the one argument the book quietly proves. We cover what happens, what it means, and the reading most people miss, and we take on the book's hardest criticism head-on.

Best for readers studying As Good As Dead for class or a book club, and anyone who wants the real takeaway — spoilers included.
